recommended_candidate.preservation: No output expressions, aggregate types, GROUP BY keys, NULL behavior, DISTINCT behavior, task state, membership, receipts, permissions, function definitions, worker code, or relay files change.
recommended_candidate.eligibility: Only proceed if the estimated plan confirms the task summary lacks a covering path. Qualify actual index selection and output equivalence locally before any deployment decision.
